unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a small open LLM with LoRA on local radiology reports to generate report conclusions
Turing-style blinded radiologist preference and rating of AI-generated versus human-written conclusions

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a fine-tuned Llama 3 model for generating radiology report impressions, evaluated via automated metrics and an offline Turing-like reader study with 13 radiologists, but it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
